image_description: Two compact audio cassettes lying side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a colorful abstract label with pink and orange stripes; the right cassette has a black label with 'MP3' and '60 min' text. Both have transparent plastic shells, visible internal spools, and standard mechanical features like write-protect tabs and screw holes.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a cassette tape and not a similar rectangular object (e.g., VHS adapter, DVD case).
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and correctness of the text on the labels, which is a common failure point in AI generation.
To verify the structural integrity of the transparent plastic shells and ensure no floating parts or merged boundaries with the background.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts missed by specific experts.

focus_areas: Transparency and refraction effects of plastic casing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the labels. AI often generates pseudo-text that looks like letters from a distance but fails OCR. Check if the 'MP3' logo is structurally sound. Also, verify if the transparent plastic shows realistic reflections/refractions or if it looks like a flat overlay.
